summary: Frontend + mongo testing of the new-skipper 'Find' guide (sample Cutlery Drawer Magic Scan -> Save contents -> Done -> magnifying glass -> search Fork) and the single-schematic fix in InventorySetupWizard. Pro skipper test-user-pro/main, 390x844 phone viewport, 4 real Magic Scans. ALL requested flows PASS end to end. 1) Galley first-help: 'Would you like some help Magic Scanning the Cutlery Drawer?' and the yes button reads 'Yes, please show me. I'd also like to know more about "Find"...' (wraps cleanly to 2 lines, 338x48 at 390px). 2) Sample dialog: zone-dialog-galley-sample-help is a yellow box (bg-yellow-200) with the new text; old 'Would you like to use this sample image' text gone; sample-use-btn has mbp-glow. 3) Use the sample image: POST /scan 200, stage 'review', scan-review-dialog shows scan-guide-instructions (title + Batch Magic Scan text) with Continue. Before Continue no rows glow. After Continue the instructions are hidden, scan-guide-save-text reads '"Fork" and "Bottle opener" once added can be searched. Click "Save contents".', and the glowing rows were 'Dinner fork' (run 1) / 'Fork' (run 2) and 'Bottle opener', plus scan-review-save-btn. 4) Save contents: stage 'done'; first-help box/yes button gone; zone-dialog-galley-find-done-hint has the right text just above Done; the only .mbp-glow in the zone dialog is zone-dialog-galley-done-btn (also after 3 s); Done is scrolled into view (752-800 of 844). 5) Done: stage 'search', find-guide-search-hint 'Now you can click the magnifying glass icon and search for Fork or Bottle opener' sits under the vessel bar, above the Lists/Home/Search row. boat-details-search-btn has mbp-glow and is in view. Both persist after a reload. 6) Negative checks: with Galley zone photos added back (3 photos) and stage 'search', there is no hint, no glow and no guide text in the dialog. The same happens with a legacy Fridge `photo` + the sample photo (2 photos); this also caught my first, incomplete data setup. 7) Magnifying glass: find-guide-search-text 'Type Fork or Bottle opener in the search box below.' and the search box glows. The hint hides while the dialog is open. Closing without typing keeps stage 'search' and the hint. Typing 'fork' changes the text to 'Tap Fork or Bottle opener below to see where it is on your boat.', the box glow goes, and inventory-search-item-<id> 'Dinner fork x16' glows. Tapping it sets stage '' and opens the Galley zone window with the Cutlery Drawer open and inventory-item-<id> highlighted, plus the Return to result set button. Afterwards there is no hint and no search-btn glow, also after a reload. 8) Cancel in Magic Scan Discoveries (through the discard prompt) sets stage ''; no later hints. 9) A normal Magic Scan (own photo through inventory-scan-input) while stage='review' shows no instructions, no save text and no glows. 10) Wizard on main with zone_maps=[]: exactly ONE POST /zone-maps; mongo shows a single 'My zone map overview'. After going all the way to Finish there is still 1 overview (1 swatch).

design_issues.screen: Galley zone window after Save contents (phone)
issues: The success toast 'Cutlery Drawer now lists 8 items' (bottom of screen, about 4 s) covers the lower half of the glowing Done button right when the guide says 'Click Done'. Done is the last element and sits at 752-800 px in an 844 px viewport. Optional: toast position top, or a shorter toast while findDone.

scan-guide-save-text is hard-coded '"Fork" and "Bottle opener"' even if the AI did not detect one of them. In the search dialog, 'Tap Fork or Bottle opener below' lists both words even when only the Fork result is shown (the query was 'fork'). Minor; consider using only the words that are present or matched.

action_items: Optional: avoid the success toast covering the glowing Done button in the Galley zone window during the find guide (phone).
Optional: build the guide copy (scan-guide-save-text, search dialog 'Tap X below') from the words actually in the scan or results, not the fixed 'Fork and Bottle opener'.
critical_code_review_comments: InventoryList.sampleScan sets stage 'review' before the scan. If the scan fails (429 no asks, network, timeout), the stage stays 'review' in localStorage. It is harmless now, because scanGuide needs scan.sample, but it is stale state. Consider findTo('') in the runScan catch when sample.

findWords only runs while the stage is 'search'. If the boat already has more than one photo when Done is pressed, the stage stays 'search' forever, with no hint. If the skipper later removes photos down to one, the hint can come back long after the fact. Consider clearing the stage when findWords returns [] at the 'done' -> 'search' step.

InventorySetupWizard: the adding ref guard is set before the first await, so the StrictMode double effect is blocked (verified: 1 POST). The backend still has no server-side guard (two concurrent POSTs from two tabs or devices would still create 'overview 2'). Acceptable.

Customer case: user_e1d640c948e6/main now has a single 'My zone map overview' with 2 swatches, updated 2026-11-27T19:20:48Z. That change came from the owner's own live preview session (session created 18:23Z; map id and path differ from the test boat's). It was NOT done by this test, and I made no changes to that user's data.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (10/10 requested flows pass; 2 minor design/copy notes)

A temporary console.log in BoatPrep.jsx used for debugging was removed (git diff clean).
